title: Been messing around with this prototype and wondering if it’s worth pursuing.
author: Insomnium_111
selftext:
I know there are still quite a few issues with it and some of the movement/gameplay feels a little janky right now, so definitely not pretending it’s anywhere near finished.

I’m trying to figure out what direction to take it if I keep going. I was thinking maybe something inspired by Tribes with bigger outdoor areas, weapons, but possibly mixing in zombies/enemies instead of just making another straight multiplayer shooter.

Not really sure yet.

Does the base gameplay look like something worth continuing with? What direction would you take it?

Mostly looking for feedback before I dump a bunch more time into it.
